wage_series_reference: average_monthly_salaries.csv; pre-1992 observations use historical_manufacturing_hourly_wages.csv where available

sources.source: Statistics Sweden (SCB), average monthly salary after sector, all sectors, total gender.
sources.unit: SEK/month; annual comparator calculated as monthly × 12
sources.definition: SCB average monthly salary across all sectors, both sexes (total gender), for each year 1992–2025. Salary is not disposable income or actual annual earnings.
sources.transformation: Annual comparator is monthly average multiplied by 12; nominal values. Monthly source values retained in the separate salary file.

sources.source: Statistics Sweden (SCB), Disponibel inkomst för hushåll efter hushållstyp och ålder, tabell 1a, totalräknade Inkomster och skatter (IoS) values where available.
sources.unit: SEK per household and year, median, fixed 2024 prices
sources.definition: Median disposable income for all households (Samtliga hushåll 18+), not per person or consumption unit. Disposable income is after tax and transfers and includes realized capital gains/losses. The source table joins the sample-based Household Finance Survey (HEK, 1991–2013) with the register-based Income and Taxes survey (IoS, 2011–2024).
sources.coverage: Sweden; observed years 1991, 1995–2024. Missing years 1992–1994. This is median household income in 2024 prices, not individual annual earnings, and is not a like-for-like replacement for gross average monthly salary.
sources.transformation: Transcribed the all-households row, median column, from the SCB workbook. For 1991–2010 use the HEK series; for 2011–2024 use the IoS series, taking IoS-revised overlapping values for 2011–2013. Converted source units from thousands of SEK to SEK by multiplying by 1,000. No extra CPI adjustment, annualization, interpolation, or income-per-capita conversion.

sources.source: Sveriges Riksbank, Historical Monetary and Financial Statistics for Sweden, Volume I, Svante Prado workbook, Tables I.A10.1 and I.A10.2.
sources.definition: Hourly earnings by manufacturing industry category and sex, plus a separately identified source-provided weighted average. Source table categories are represented in Swedish in the CSV.
sources.coverage: Sweden; manufacturing workers. Coverage varies by industry and sex. Male categories are observed from 1860 or later depending on category; female coverage starts between 1865 and 1952 by category. Male weighted average 1871–2013; female weighted average 1921–2013.
sources.transformation: Transcribed source observations without annualization or interpolation. Missing cells are omitted. This sectoral hourly series is not directly equivalent to all-sector monthly salary; overlap does not imply equivalent population or method.

sources.source: Swedish Nintendo price observations from dated retail catalogues/advertisements (1987, 1991–1994), plus annual Swedish sales volumes and sales values by Nintendo platform from Dataspelsbranschen reports (1998–2015).
sources.unit: Nominal SEK/game where documented; 2010–2015 nominal EUR/game only
sources.definition: Retired mixed-publisher aggregate series of nominal SEK per game. It combined unverified mixed-title catalogue samples and average expenditure on software sold for Nintendo platforms, including third-party games. It is not a Nintendo first-party price series and is excluded from the public data output.
sources.coverage: Archived research only. Values formerly shown for 1987, 1991–1994 and 1998–2015 are not used on the Nintendo software page because underlying title-level publisher data is unavailable or sources cover all software for Nintendo platforms. No first-party-only annual price series is currently published.
sources.transformation: No longer loaded into or published by the pipeline. The original input CSV is retained as a repository archive for audit; it must not be used as Nintendo-only annual values. No interpolation or replacement estimates.
sources.verification_limitations: Audit 2026-11-16: seven catalogue means cannot be fully independently recalculated because individual title-price transcriptions are absent; the 1992 issue 13 PDF URL returned 404. Retained values remain qualified source samples, not newly fully verified statistics. Historical report labels include Game Boy Advance in 2000, preceding hardware release; aggregate values follow the source as reported and do not establish platform release dates.

sources.source: Nördliv, dated price statements in reviews explicitly identifying the tested Nintendo Switch / Switch 2 version; original quoted sources are Prisjakt, Nintendo/eShop and DekuDeals. These are secondary reported price observations, not transaction-level official statistics.
sources.unit: nominal SEK/game; reported lowest price per title at the source-stated date
sources.definition: A research archive of individual exact SEK lowest-price quotations for Nintendo-published Nintendo Switch/Switch 2 games in Swedish reviews. Titles are included only where Nintendo's official game page identifies Nintendo as publisher. These remain secondary observed lowest prices, not launch list prices or annual game-price averages. The sources do not separately document VAT per quote; no tax adjustment or foreign currency conversion is applied. Excludes third-party-published titles, hardware, accessories, subscriptions and add-ons.
sources.coverage: 14 retained price observations for Nintendo-published titles, 2019–2025, sourced from Swedish reviews and retrieved 2026-11-16. No eligible Nintendo-published title observation was present in this review sample for 2017–2018 or 2026. The changing title and channel sample is not a representative annual average. Individual observations are preserved for research only and are not used as annual chart/table values.
sources.transformation: No annual mean or other aggregate is published from this archive. Retain exact reported SEK amount, source URL/date/platform and a Nintendo official page URL supporting Nintendo as publisher for each title. Inclusion: explicit tested Switch version; exact SEK amount; named price source; source-stated date in publication year and no later than publication, at most 45 days before publication. Exclude third-party-published games, approximate amounts, foreign currency, contradictory years/dates and prices explicitly for another platform. No other conversions or estimates.
